subject.title: [F8] Session status code=2 errors not reflected in OTel error counts

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated `session.ended` diagnostics/OTel contract now, and should the `openclaw.end_reason` taxonomy be owned here or by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102019?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent telemetry surface and reason enum become operator-facing contracts, so automation should not invent the public contract without maintainer direction.

options.title: Add canonical session-ended telemetry
options.body: Add a trusted `session.ended` diagnostics path with OTel error status/message and a maintained end-reason enum, then update diagnostics-otel, trajectory docs, and focused tests together.

options.title: Scope this issue to OTel counting
options.body: Fix only the OTel status/counting behavior for failed sessions and leave the semantic end-reason enum to the related issue.

options.title: Fold into the end-reason issue
options.body: Treat the OTel counting and end-reason gaps as one broader session-lifecycle telemetry project tracked by the related issue.

recommendation.title: Add canonical session-ended telemetry
recommendation.body: Add a trusted `session.ended` diagnostics path with OTel error status/message and a maintained end-reason enum, then update diagnostics-otel, trajectory docs, and focused tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the documented Agents/telemetry owner and recently merged diagnostics-otel changes in the same service area.
